title: Java Full Stack developer
description:
Akkodis is seeking a Java Full Stack developer for a Contract with a client in Chicago, IL(Hybrid). Candidates must have strong hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and modern front-end technologies.

Rate Range: $53/hour to $56/hour; The rate may be negotiable based on experience, education, geographic location, and other factors.

Java Full Stack developer job responsibilities include:
• Develop and maintain full-stack applications using ReactJS for the front end and Java with Spring Boot for the back end.
• Design and implement microservices architecture, ensuring scalability and performance across distributed systems.
• Integrate REST APIs and manage event-driven systems using technologies like Apache Kafka and JMS.
• Deploy applications using CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, and Concourse.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to perform code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, and ensure adherence to ITIL processes.
• Continuously improve application performance and reliability, leveraging DevOps practices and cloud platforms like Azure.

Required Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in full-stack development using Java and ReactJS.
• Strong expertise in building microservices with Spring Boot and integrating REST APIs.
• Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools and cloud platforms, preferably Azure, along with DevOps automation skills.

If you are interested in this role, then please click APPLY NOW. For other opportunities available at Akkodis, or any questions, feel free to contact me at Shashank.Tewari@akkodisgroup.com.

Pay Details: $53.00 to $56.00 per hour

Benefit offerings available for our associates include medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, additional voluntary benefits, EAP program, commuter benefits and a 401K plan.
